text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown brilliantly claims victory in 
the showdown amidst the rain. Kitasan 
Black earnestly pleads to race 
again—asking for a rematch at the Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black holds the advantage at 
middle distance. That is precisely why 
Satono Crown accepts the challenge. The 
higher the wall, the stronger it will make 
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That heated race lit a fire in the hearts 
of all who watched. Driven by the urge to 
win, Cheval Grand decides to enter the 
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup swirls with passion. Satono 
Crown heightens her expectations.
